en: A black-and-white postcard image featuring a broad river (Indalsälven) viewed from a grassy hillside with a few people, a small shelter, and what appears to be hay stacking in the foreground. In the river, a boat with a sail can be seen. Rolling hills and mountains stretch into the distance under a cloudy sky. The postcard includes clear Swedish text identifying the view.
